name: Afterward: A Gay Series
source:
Afterward: A Gay Series (AAGS) is a fictional, contemporary, slice-of-life series of stories set in the YAGS universe, following a gay man's journey of coming out, accepting himself, and finding love.

[From [url=https://bobcgames.itch.io/aags]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《后来：同性恋系列》(AAGS) 是一部虚构的、当代的、生活片段的系列故事，以YAGS宇宙为背景，讲述了一名同性恋男子出柜、接受自己和寻找真爱的旅程。

[来自[url=https://bobcgames.itch.io/aags]Itch.io[/url]]
